title: B.J. Blazkowicz's impossible choice in Wolfenstein
subject: blazkowicz
description:
Fergus or Wyatt: who did you save? 👇

The choice in Deathshead's lab that splits Wolfenstein into two timelines. Spoilers for Wolfenstein: The New Order.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by MachineGames or Bethesda Softworks. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Deathshead made B.J. pick which friend would die on his table.
Fergus Reid, a gruff Scottish captain, and Probst Wyatt III, a nervous young private, lie strapped down in his lab.
B.J. has seconds to answer. The man he doesn't name is taken away.
The game never undoes it. Save Fergus and you can hotwire machines. Save Wyatt and you can pick locks.
Fourteen years later, B.J. finds the other man again. His brain is wired inside one of Deathshead's robots.
That one answer follows B.J. into the sequel, where it decides which friend is still fighting beside him.
